# Tencent Hunyuan Image Generation · Native DSH Plugin
Languages: **English** · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Português · Español · Русский

> Bring Tencent Hunyuan's **Hy-Image-3.5-preview** and **Hy-Image-3.0** into
> DSH (DeepSeek Harness

) — with a generation panel, local gallery,
> the official two-step size picker and batch generation

.
> **Zero native dependencies. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.**
## ✨ Features

- **Two models**
- `hy-image-v3.5-preview` — Chat/Messages protocol; multimodal input, multi-turn ed

iting,
chain-of-thought rewriting; up to **4K (4096×4096)** output
- `hy-image-v3` — classic text-to

-image; prompt rewriting and the official 37 preset sizes
- **Official two-step size picker** — **re

solution tier × aspect ratio**, the same interaction as
the Tencent TokenHub web console. The plugin

converts your choice into the `WxH` string the API
expects and guarantees it satisfies the official

constraints
(v3.5: edges in [256, 8192], area ≤ 16,777,216; v3.0: edges in [512, 2048], area ≤ 1,04

8,576).
The UI shows the exact size that will be sent.
- **Batch generation** — generate **1 / 2 / 4

images** in one request (issued in parallel);
results are shown one by one with a `1/4` index badge

. Partial failures are reported explicitly.
- **Local gallery**
- Every successful generation is **s

tored automatically** (plain-JS JSON storage — no SQLite, no native module)
- **Thumbnail grid** and

list views
- **Keyword search** (matches the prompt and the rewritten prompt) plus filtering by mod

el and time range
- **Detail drawer** with the full prompt, model, size, timestamp and local path
-

**🔁 Generate again** — refills the original prompt and parameters in one click
- Multi-select **batc

h delete** (also removes the local files), copy prompt, copy image
- **Customisable output folder**

— defaults to `~/Pictures/DSH-Hunyuan-Image`, but you can point it
anywhere (a non-system drive is r

ecommended). Clicking **"Choose…"** opens the native OS folder picker.
**Changes take effect immedia

tely, no plugin restart needed.** Files are bucketed by month under
`<folder>/<YYYY-MM>/` to avoid p

iling thousands of files into one directory.
- **Official advanced parameters** (session-scoped on p
urpose — see Roadmap)
| Parameter | Applies to | Description |

| Seed `seed` | both | Reproduce the same result |
| Watermark footnote `footnote` | both | ≤ 16 cha

racters, rendered in the bottom-right corner |
| External search augmentation `use_search_tool` | v3

.5 | Let the model search the web before drawing |
[该节后续省略]

rmanent folder, e.g. `~/dsh-plugins/`:

Please install `~/dsh-plugins/package` as a DSH plugin (use `plugin_manager` with `install_bundle`).

Then add the plugin name to the profile's `package.json` (in both `dependencies` and

ndles`) and restart DSH.
## ⚙️ Configuration
### 1. Get an API Key

1. Sign up / log in at Tencent Cloud
2. Activate the TokenHub service
3. Create a Key on the API Key

page — it looks like `sk-...`
4. Enable **pay-as-you-go** for `hy-image-v3.5-preview` and `hy-image

-v3` under
Online inference → Vision models
## ⚠️ Known limitations & roadmap
### Limitations (imposed by the Tencent API or the DSH host)
| Item | Detail |
| **Remote image URL lifetime** | Only 12 hours — this plugin downloads every image to disk immediat

ely, so gallery entries are permanent |
| **Reference image size** | v3.5 ≤ 20 MB each; v3.0 ≤ 10 MB

each |
| **Reference image count** | v3.5 ≤ 20; v3.0 ≤ 3 |
| **Watermark footnote** | ≤ 16 UTF-8 ch

aracters |
| **`generate_max_pixels` caps at 2K** | Higher resolutions must go through `size` (this

plugin does that via the resolution tier) |
| **Multi-turn editing** | v3.5 only. The plugin stores

the server-returned `assembled_history`, but there is no UI for multi-turn editing yet |
| **Advance
d parameters are not persisted** | The external-search, reference-area-cap and rewrite toggles apply
to the **current session only** and reset when the panel is reopened. This is deliberate — it avoid
s hidden state that is hard to diagnose later |
### Architecture notes

- **Two entries**: `dist/server.js` is the Host half (Node.js process) and `dist/client.js` is the
C

lient half (browser). The latter must be in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})` format,
pr

oduced by `scripts/build-client.mjs` via esbuild; JSX is force-compiled to
`React.createElement` bec

ause the DSH module table provides `React` but **not** `react/jsx-runtime`.
- **UI entry point**: th

e client registers a single `conversation.composer.dock` slot (a button).
Clicking it opens an overl

ay with three tabs: Generate / Gallery / Settings.
- **Client ↔ host**: the client calls the host th

rough `fetch('/hunyuan/api/<method>')`; images are
served back through `/hunyuan/file?path=<absolute

path>` (restricted to files inside the
configured output folder, to prevent path traversal).
- **Ze

ro native dependencies**: the gallery is a JSON file rather than SQLite, so it loads fine under
the

macOS code-signing / hardened-runtime restrictions of the DSH app, and needs no rebuild on
Windows o

de-signing / hardened-runtime restrictions of the DSH app, and needs no rebuild on
Windows or Linux.
